confiance.q1: When your partner goes out with friends in the evening, you…
confiance.q1a: Have a good evening on your own side, without really thinking about it.
confiance.q1b: Feel relaxed, though you appreciate a short message during the evening.
confiance.q1c: Wonder who they're really with and what they're doing.
confiance.q1d: Feel anxious and check your phone regularly.
confiance.q2: Your partner gets a message late at night and smiles. Your first thought…
confiance.q2a: It's surely a friend or something funny, nothing to worry about.
confiance.q2b: You're curious but don't ask, it isn't necessarily your business.
confiance.q2c: You feel a pang and want to ask who it is.
confiance.q2d: You immediately imagine the worst-case scenario.
confiance.q3: Have you ever looked at your partner's phone without them knowing?
confiance.q3a: Never, I have neither the desire nor the need.
confiance.q3b: I've thought about it but I didn't do it.
confiance.q3c: Once or twice, out of curiosity or worry.
confiance.q4: If your partner forgets to mention a lunch with a colleague…
confiance.q4a: It's not a big deal, they don't have to report every detail to me.
confiance.q4b: You notice it but you don't make a drama of it.
confiance.q4c: You wonder why they didn't mention it, it nags at you.
confiance.q4d: You experience it as concealment and question them about it.
confiance.q5: When your partner makes you a promise, you think…
confiance.q5a: They'll keep their word, as usual.
confiance.q5b: Probably, even if they sometimes forget details.
confiance.q5c: I hope so, but I'd rather not count on it too much.
confiance.q5d: I don't really believe it any more, too many broken promises.
confiance.q6: How do you handle passwords and personal accounts as a couple?
confiance.q6a: Each of us has a private life, no need to share everything.
confiance.q6b: We share some access but we respect each other's space.
confiance.q6c: I'd like access to everything, to feel reassured.
confiance.q6d: Not having access to my partner's accounts makes me suspicious.
confiance.q7: Your partner has to work late with a colleague. Your reaction…
confiance.q7a: No problem, I trust them professionally.
confiance.q7b: I understand, even if I'd rather they came home early.
confiance.q7c: I'm not very comfortable but I say nothing.
confiance.q7d: I find it hard not to picture uncomfortable scenarios.
confiance.q8: After a breach of trust (a lie, cheating), do you think trust can come back?
confiance.q8a: Yes, with time, transparency and real work on both sides.
confiance.q8b: It's possible but very hard, it takes years.
confiance.q8c: I doubt it, once trust is broken it's almost beyond repair.
confiance.q8d: No, it's impossible for me to trust again after that.
confiance.q9: How often do you feel the need to be reassured about your partner's feelings?
confiance.q9a: Rarely, I can feel that things are solid between us.
confiance.q9c: Fairly often, I need to hear that everything is fine.
confiance.q9d: Constantly, without reassurance the anxiety builds.
confiance.q10: When your partner spends time on social media…
confiance.q10a: That's their business, it doesn't bother me.
confiance.q10b: It's not a problem for me, as long as it stays reasonable.
confiance.q10c: I sometimes wonder what they're looking at or who they're talking to.
confiance.q10d: I monitor their likes, their follows and their interactions.
confiance.q11: Can you share your deepest fears with your partner?
confiance.q11a: Yes, they're the person I trust the most.
confiance.q11b: Most of them, though some things stay hard to put into words.
confiance.q11c: Few, I'm afraid it would be used against me or misunderstood.
confiance.q11d: No, I don't feel safe enough for that.
confiance.q12: When your partner criticises something you do…
confiance.q12a: I listen and try to understand, without taking it personally.
confiance.q12b: It stings a little but I know it's constructive.
confiance.q12c: I feel attacked and I tend to defend myself.
confiance.q12d: I take it as proof that they don't accept me as I am.
confiance.q13: If your partner had to travel alone with a friend of the opposite sex…
confiance.q13a: No problem at all, trust has nothing to do with a friend's gender.
confiance.q13b: I'd be a bit uncomfortable but I wouldn't stop them.
confiance.q13c: I'd struggle to accept it, it would make me anxious.
confiance.q13d: Out of the question, that's a deal-breaker for me.
confiance.q14: How do you react when your partner holds a very different opinion from yours?
confiance.q14a: It's enriching, we can be different and still respect each other.
confiance.q14b: Sometimes frustrating, but I understand it's normal.
confiance.q14c: I find it hard, I wonder whether we're really compatible.
confiance.q14d: It makes me doubt how solid our relationship is.
confiance.q15: How transparent are you with your partner about money?
confiance.q15a: Completely, we talk about money openly and regularly.
confiance.q15b: Fairly, we each know the broad picture of the other's situation.
confiance.q15c: Partly, some financial subjects remain off-limits.
confiance.q15d: Very little, money is a subject I avoid entirely.
confiance.q16: When you make a mistake in the relationship, you…
confiance.q16a: I admit it quickly and we talk it through to move forward.
confiance.q16b: I try to bring it up even when it's uncomfortable.
confiance.q16c: I play it down or wait for them to notice.
confiance.q16d: I hide it, owning up could destroy what we have.
confiance.q17: Do you think your partner is honest with you day to day?
confiance.q17a: Yes, I have no doubt about their honesty.
confiance.q17b: Broadly yes, even if they sometimes soften the truth.
confiance.q17c: I'm not always sure, some subjects seem to be avoided.
confiance.q17d: I have recurring doubts about their sincerity.
confiance.q18: When you disagree, do you manage to stay respectful towards each other?
confiance.q18a: Always, disagreement never puts respect into question.
confiance.q18b: Most of the time, even if we sometimes raise our voices.
confiance.q18c: It depends, some conflicts get out of hand and hurtful things get said.
confiance.q18d: Rarely, our arguments are often verbally violent.
confiance.q19: If your partner confessed to a serious mistake (a lie, a hidden expense)…
confiance.q19a: I'd appreciate their honesty and we'd look for a solution together.
confiance.q19b: I'd be hurt but able to discuss it after some time to think.
confiance.q19c: I'd find it very hard to forgive, trust would be badly shaken.
confiance.q19d: It would probably be the end of the relationship for me.
confiance.q20: Overall, how would you describe the trust in your relationship?
confiance.q20a: Solid, natural and mutual, it's the foundation of our relationship.
confiance.q20b: Present and fairly stable, with a few normal moments of doubt.
confiance.q20c: Fragile, I'd like to trust but something stops me.
confiance.q20d: Almost absent, I live in day-to-day suspicion.
confiance.r1_d: Your relationship seems to be going through a significant crisis of trust. Doubts, unspoken things or past wounds weigh heavily on your daily life. This isn't a judgement, it's a warning signal.
confiance.r1_a: Trust can be rebuilt, but it takes sincere commitment from both sides. Professional support (couples therapy) can help you lay the ground for a fresh start. Don't wait for the situation to get worse.
confiance.r2_d: Trust is there at times, but certain situations weaken it. You've probably identified sensitive subjects or controlling reflexes that deserve your attention.
confiance.r2_a: Talk openly about these grey areas with your partner. Unspoken things usually feed mistrust more than reality does. Set up regular communication rituals to defuse tension before it settles in.
confiance.r3_t: Solid trust with a few cracks
confiance.r3_d: Overall, you trust your partner and they trust you. A few points of vigilance remain, but nothing worrying. Your relationship rests on healthy foundations.
confiance.r3_a: Keep cultivating transparency and communication. Small daily gestures (keeping your promises, being reliable) strengthen trust day after day. You're on the right track!
confiance.r4_d: Well done! Your relationship rests on solid, reciprocal trust. You feel emotionally safe, free to be yourself and able to count on each other without anxiety.
confiance.r4_a: This trust is a treasure, don't take it for granted. Keep being transparent, keep your commitments and welcome your partner's vulnerability. That's what makes the good stories last.
